supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to supervise and fund you; contact supervisors before applying.
supervisor.quote: Admission is based on evaluation by the Graduate Training Committee and on acceptance by a faculty member within the department who agrees to supervise and fund the applicant. | Prospective students should have connected with prospective faculty supervisors prior to submitting their application for admission.

funding.value: Admission requires a supervisor who agrees to fund you; Canadian and international students are supported.
funding.quote: acceptance by a faculty member within the department who agrees to supervise and fund the applicant

also.quote: both Canadian and international students benefit from financial support

entry_route.value: Apply with a master's, or fast-track to PhD 1 from a BSc with a CGPA of 3.7/4.
entry_route.quote: Students who wish to be fast tracked to Ph.D1 with a B.Sc must have a minimum CGPA of 3.7/4.
